on:
  push:
    branches:
      - lab/afw-c2-source-20261117-first-failure-diag2-toy

jobs:

    if: >-
      github.repository == 'tokenizartinfo-ops/agent-friendly-web' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/lab/afw-c2-source-20261117-first-failure-diag2-toy' &&

      github.event.head_commit.message == 'AFW-C2-FIRST-FAILURE-POST-DIAG2-TOY-ONEUSE-20261117'

    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:

          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Use the fixed toy Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
